selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-worker runs the requested executable under the dedicated inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: Proves account creation, valid systemd configuration, enabled/active state, requested ExecStart, and matching process/account UID 996.
Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, fully running system, and recovered enabled/active worker process under inventorysvc.

commands.command:
set -eu
if getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then
  printf '%s\n' 'inventorysvc already exists'
else
  useradd --system --user-group --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
  printf '%s\n' 'inventorysvc created'
fi
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventorysvc
passwd -S inventorysvc

set -eu
install -o root -g root -m 0644 /dev/null /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'INVENTORY_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
INVENTORY_UNIT
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
sed -n '1,160p' /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
